what: The erratum of 2026-10-09: the control page counted closed forms refuted by a FLOAT comparison (Math.sqrt, Math.pow, Math.exp, a midpoint times a rational) as refutations, and the engine ledger counted REJECT — which included enclosures that STRADDLE the bar — as decisions. This record pins the numbers as they were published, so the correction can be verified against the bytes it corrects. The after-numbers are read from the rebuilt ledger by tools/build-control.js.

before.newmanStatement: an n-term Newman polynomial whose certified min|f| on |z|=1 exceeds every value achievable with fewer terms

sentences.index.html (stat): A refutation here is proved, not unlikely.

mechanism.float_refutations: machine/engine.js relations(): test(label, val) with val a double — exact for p/q (monotone rounding), not for sqrt(p/q), (p/q)·c with c a midpoint, c^(p/q) by Math.pow; families/oeis-closedform.js forms(): the same for sqrt, cbrt, (a+b√d)/c, constant multiples and powers, products and quotients of constants, log and exp of rationals. Only rational survivors were re-decided exactly.
mechanism.reject_straddle: machine/engine.js:58-60 sent any verdict word other than HIT or REFUSED to rejects; families/cosine.js:48 and families/newman.js:41 said REJECT whenever the enclosure failed to clear the bar, straddles included; families/oeis-closedform.js said REJECT for not-a-discovery; families/strassen-audit.js said REJECT for certified-correct-not-fast.
mechanism.newman_bar: families/newman.js:41 compared candidate.modSq[0] with the champion lower end (envelope.barSq); a proof of exceeding needs candidate.lo > champion.hi.
mechanism.history: tools/test-engine.js:60-64 records that the float mechanism once refuted sqrt(2) as a closed form for the decimal expansion of sqrt(2); it was repaired then at the enclosure (17 digits, 4 ulps outward), not at the comparison. This erratum repairs the comparison.

repair: candidates are exact rationals or enclosures (instruments/interval/algebraic.js, transcendental.js); a form is refuted only on DISJOINTNESS; rational powers c^(p/q) with q > 1 in the engine hunt are refused rather than evaluated; one verdict module instruments/verdict.js with decide(enclosure, bar, relation) splits REJECT into REFUTED and REFUSED; unknown words are REFUSED and counted; the Newman bar is the champion enclosure and the comparison is candidate.lo > bar.hi.

rederived.what: The kernel (instruments/interval/interval.js) changed, so every record that pins the certifier modules' sha256 was re-derived by the new bytes the same day; the decisions were compared field by field with the records they replaced.
